title: Metric window rollup pages on-call for a minute that never spiked
summary: The per-minute web.5xx rollup an on-call SRE watches reports one window higher than the metering dashboard, and it is one boundary sample away from paging someone at 3am.

company.notes: Observability-shaped metric aggregation over fixed time windows; a half-open-vs-closed boundary error, no syntax fault.

expected_output:
=== web.5xx per 60s window ===
12:00:00  count=2  sum=5
12:01:00  count=2  sum=9
12:02:00  count=1  sum=1
buggy_output:
=== web.5xx per 60s window ===
12:00:00  count=3  sum=10
12:01:00  count=2  sum=9
12:02:00  count=1  sum=1

phase2.spec_patch: Ops also needs the web.4xx metric rolled up the same way, printed in its own section below the existing one. Same 60-second windows, same dedup, same output shape.
